Post 1
📉 ASX 200 cracked below its 200-day moving average Wednesday, closing at 8,821.80, down 61.40pts or 0.69%. Down 3.62% over five days. The trend is no longer your friend. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
Tech led the selling, off 2.31%. Materials dropped 1.08%, Consumer Discretionary 1.05%. Only Energy and Utilities held ground, up 0.46% and 0.12% respectively. Defensive rotation underway. #ASX #ausbiz #energy

Post 3
🔻 Lendlease collapsed 16.91% to AUD 1.720 — the session's sharpest single-stock move. That kind of print signals something structural, not just sentiment. Watch for further institutional repositioning. #ASX #property #ausbiz

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 5,629.90/oz kept materials bulls interested. Silver AUD 68.40/oz, Platinum AUD 2,082.48/oz. With AUD/USD at 0.6722, offshore commodity tailwinds remain real for local producers. #gold #metals #ASX

Post 5
Key line in the sand: can ASX 200 reclaim 8,883 — its 200-day MA — before week's end? Five-day loss of 3.62% demands a catalyst. What's your read — dead-cat bounce or deeper correction? #ASX #ausbiz #trading
